facts.fact: A panel at Mali's 4th Semaine du Numerique, with experts from Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, discussed drawing up a roadmap to universal coverage in Mali by 2030 (the document gives only the panel date, 2026-07-30, as the event date and names no adopted plan).
facts.system: feuille de route pour la couverture universelle a l'horizon 2030
